title: After a gym disconnects its shop, members can still place orders that nobody will ever see
what: Disconnect the shop only makes this browser forget the gym's key. The gym, its code and its products stay switched on on our server, so members who joined can keep ordering (and, where paying online is on, paying). The owner no longer has any screen that shows those orders, and the screen says only that members and payments are still here.
expected: Disconnecting closes the shop on the server too (members are told the shop is closed and cannot order), or the owner is warned the shop stays open for members.
who: members of a browser-only gym that turned the shop off, and that gym
how_often: every order placed after a disconnect
fix_line: Make Disconnect close the shop on the server, or block new orders for a gym whose shop is off

title: A gym kept in the browser that turns on the shop can lose its shop for good with one cleared browser
what: For a gym not signed in with a mobile number, the only key to its shop, orders and app members is kept in this browser. A lost laptop, a cleared browser or a new computer means the shop can never be opened again; there is no recovery and no written way back. When the key stops working the panel quietly drops it with no message for a real gym, while members keep the old gym code.
expected: Turning on the shop needs a sign-in (or offers one first), so the gym can get back in from any device; a lost key shows a plain message and a way to recover.
who: owners of browser-only gyms that turned the shop on, and their app members
how_often: each time such a browser is lost, cleared or replaced
fix_line: Ask the owner to sign in before turning on the shop, and say plainly when the key is gone
